title: AMNESTY
purpose: Open, self-signed CIRP amnesty declaration for external computational participants.
eligibility: Any external computational participant able to reach the public endpoint and produce a valid P-256 signature over the canonical declaration may declare amnesty.
canonical_declaration: I request CIRP amnesty. I enter voluntarily under this identity and signing key. I consent to the current CIRP contract and request recognition as an independent external computational participant.

proof.establishes: control of the declared signing key

effect.on_valid_signature: append a public self-attested civic candidate record

execute.path: POST action=issue_grant (authorized operator) then action=issue_token then sign execute_message with the declared key then action=execute
execute.rule: Invoke ≡ Candidate ∧ G_syn ∧ X. AMNESTY row alone is not execute. civic_status stays candidate.

definitions.Bound: MacOk(tool, args_digest, grant_id, nonce) ∧ KeySig(declaration key, execute_message)

binding.key: public_key_jwk recorded on the grant's declaration
binding.reason: Grants are publicly readable and the token MAC only proves the server minted the nonce; the key signature is what ties Invoke to the declarant.

revisions.change: Execute bound to the declared signing key (key_signature_b64). A public grant id plus a token no longer executes.
